title: Two Channels at Once
description: A delivered shipment is important enough to page the customer on both email and SMS, not just one. Confirm both mock channels actually fire for that specific event, while a merely booked shipment only ever fires email.
successCondition: Book a shipment as a customer, then drive it to delivered via repeated POST /api/tracking/:id/advance calls as a dispatcher/admin. After waiting past the notification queue delay, GET /api/notifications/outbox as admin, filtered by the customer's email (?to=<email>), shows a message with subject "Shipment delivered" and channel "email". A second call to the outbox filtered by the customer's derived mock phone number (+1555 followed by the first 7 hex characters of their user id, with hyphens stripped) shows a message with the same delivered event and channel "sms".
hints: The mock phone number formula is documented exactly in docs/api/notifications.md — derive it from the customer's own user id, don't guess or copy an example.
The booked event only sends email, not sms — a good sanity check is confirming there's no sms-channel message for the booking event itself, only for the later delivered one.
